comment: The tools that `tauri build` or `tauri bundle` downloads to make an AppImage, pinned. The bundler of Tauri downloads them without a check and takes whatever is at the address, one of them from a release called 'continuous' that is replaced all the time. scripts/linux-tools.mjs puts these files, checked against the SHA-256 here, into the folder where the bundler looks first, so that it downloads nothing. The files are made for x86_64. To update one: download it, read what changed, compute the SHA-256 yourself, and change it here. 'file' is the name the bundler looks for (tauri-bundler, bundle/linux/appimage/linuxdeploy.rs). The two script plugins of the bundler (gtk and gstreamer) are inside the Tauri CLI and are not downloaded.
